column547:
Alaska Dog & Puppy Rescue (ADPR) was originally formed as a rescue organization to help meet the needs of the Mat-Su Valley & its pet overpopulation problem. Although we focus more heavily on rescues in the Mat-Su Valley & Anchorage, we work in connection with village rescue groups & air freight companies saving numerous dogs in the Bush & other outlying areas.
We are an all-volunteer organization. We rescue, advocate & educate the public on responsible pet ownership & the importance of spaying and neutering. We strive to be advocates for dogs in our community & elsewhere, & educate the public on responsible pet ownership.
Please fill out one of our online forms if you are interested in fostering, adopting, or volunteering for AKDPR.
